categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Matches the Private Broadcast label prior and directly targets transaction origin privacy by altering how unconfirmed transactions are re-exposed to peers.
categories.rationale: Disabling wallet resubmissions under `-privatebroadcast` prevents a node from exposing itself as the origin over clearnet when the wider network has dropped a transaction. This fixes a clear privacy leak where locally retained transactions are served to peers upon request, contradicting the privacy guarantees expected under `-privatebroadcast`.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Touches src/wallet/wallet.cpp and src/wallet/wallet.h, has the Wallet label, and modifies wallet rebroadcast logic.
categories.rationale: Suppresses unconfirmed transaction resubmission to the mempool on startup, imports, and periodic schedules when `-privatebroadcast` is set. It resolves a significant privacy defect where transactions associated with the wallet, such as incoming dust, are unexpectedly rebroadcast.
